text:
noah: Quick sync  billing team keeps seeing mismatched "billed project" in dashboards when SAs hit pooled capacity. Can we align console + metrics?

rita: Seen it. Console uses pre-routing header; billing uses post-routing project. Customers confused.

omar: Short-term: emit a low-cardinality metric `auth.routing.fallback_total{reason}` and a sampled `auth.routing.decision` event with `routing_hash` + short ids.

liz: UX: console should show two compact labels: `Billed project` and `Acting SA`. Tooltip explains pooled billing + link to request pinned capacity. Flag behind `ui.routing.billing.v1`.

noah: Cardinality concern?

omar: Keep ids short (no emails), sample events by org (0.5% default), 100% for support orgs. Metrics are authoritative counts (unaffected by sampling).

rita: Private installs: aggregated-only default, add `telemetry.routing_mode=aggregated|detailed` for opt-in.

devbot: deploy queued: router-canary-7. CI: green.

liz: Alerting: create soft alert when fallback_rate(org,30m) > 0.5% -> notify triage; escalate to pager if >1% for 1h. Use metric fractions.

omar: Impl checklist: router adds `routing_hash` to request context; emit metric sync; post sampled event async; retention 30d. Console drilldown uses `routing_hash` so URLs don't leak project ids.

noah: I'll open PRs for router + metrics and a short CS blurb for tooltips. Please review quickly so we can land in canary. :thumbsup:
